messages:
Alex: Quick heads-up — our 0.9.2 release is scheduled for tomorrow 11:00 PT. Console + docs freeze at 09:00 PT. Need SDK docs regen, console routes deploy, and changelog updates before cutoff. @Maria @Raj @Sam can each confirm what you'll handle? Also please avoid merging UI-affecting PRs after cutoff.

Maria: I can run Python + TS SDK docs regen. Planning to run scripts at 06:30 PT and open the version bump PR. ETA to have the generated artifacts linked by ~07:15 PT. Command I'll use: `./scripts/gen_docs.sh --sdks python,ts --out site/sdk --tag release/v0.9.2`

Raj: I'll take the console changelog, release notes, and verify UI strings. Can someone confirm the final tag + list of models to mention in rollout notes? I'll do a quick smoke at 08:30 PT.

Alex: Tag is `release/v0.9.2`. Models to document in the notes: `gpt-redwood-1.2`, `rw-embed-v1`. Also note the console route `/models` adds an optional `variant` query param — Raj, please add to the UX changelog.

Sam: Quick Q — does the SDK bump require any migration callouts? I have a minor breaking rename in the embeddings client.

Jen: FYI — embeddings param rename is backwards-compatible via runtime fallback, but we should add a deprecation note in the changelog. I'll draft the line. :thumbsup:

Maria: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/428 — docs artifact attached and build started. Output staged at `gs://redwood-docs/tmp/0.9.2-sdk`.

docs-bot: automated check — site build succeeded on commit `abc123` (preview id 426): https://deploy-preview/426 — :white_check_mark:

Alex: Deployment plan: docs deploy 09:15 PT, console canary 10:30 PT, full rollout by 11:00 PT. @deploy-bot please schedule docs at 09:15 and console canary at 10:30.

deploy-bot: scheduled docs: 2026-03-18T09:15:00-07:00, console-canary: 2026-03-18T10:30:00-07:00

Sam: Noted. I'll hold merges to `main` for console + API routes after 08:55 PT. If an urgent fix is required after cutoff, label the PR `release/0.9.2-hotfix` and ping me directly.

Raj: Found a tiny UI string mismatch in `/models` when testing variant param. Pushing a patch now — will tag `release/v0.9.2-ui.1` if needed.

Alex: If any PR needs expedited review, @me or @Sam and include the `release/0.9.2` label. Also: migration checklist is pinned in this channel.

Jen: Adding deprecation note to SDK changelog and regenerating the markdown. cc @Maria for docs sync.

Maria: Done — docs-bot built preview: https://deploy-preview/426. Please spot-check the SDK examples, changelog section, and the new `variant` param example.

Sam: Looks good overall. :eyes: Spotted a small typo in the embeddings example; pushed a tiny commit to Maria's PR.

Maria: Thanks — rebuilding preview now.

docs-bot: preview 426 rebuild passed. :white_check_mark:

Alex: Final reminder — cutoff 09:00 PT sharp. If you absolutely need a merge after cutoff, ping me or Sam with justification. Otherwise we'll proceed with scheduled deploys.

Raj: Understood. I'll wait for the held-window to expire before any more UI merges.

Maria: One last note — I included an SDK snippet showing both old and new param names to make the deprecation smoother. Example in docs:```js
// embeddings usage
const e = await client.embeddings.create({ input: 'hello', model: 'rw-embed-v1', fallback_param_name: true });
```

Sam: Nice — that should reduce support tickets. :+1:

Alex: Thanks everyone. I'll post a short release checklist in the channel 30m before cutoff.
